headline: 电影新剧双线升温
summary: 电影热作《泥面人》《荒野丛林》领跑，新剧《最低工资》《雅嘎疑云》《幻视任务》首播，热播剧《侠探杰克》《水晶湖》持续吸睛。

industryHighlights.text: 本周电影热作包括《泥面人》《荒野丛林》《小羊肖恩3：怪兽来袭》等。
industryHighlights.en: This week's hot movies include Clayface, Wildwood and Shaun the Sheep 3: Monster Attack.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧《最低工资》《雅嘎疑云》《幻视任务》本周首播。
industryHighlights.en: New series Minimum Wage, Yaga Mystery and Vision Quest premiere this week.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧《侠探杰克》《水晶湖》《魔女嘉莉》《菜鸟老警》持续更新。
industryHighlights.en: Hit series Reacher, Crystal Lake, Carrie and The Rookie continue to air.

industryHighlights.text: 待映《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》《哥斯拉-0.0》与待播《银翼杀手2099》等备受期待。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films Avengers 5, Dune 3, Godzilla -0.0 and series Blade Runner 2099 are highly anticipated.

headlineEn: Film and TV Slates Heat Up
summaryEn: Movie highlights Clayface and Wildwood lead, while new series Minimum Wage, Yaga Mystery and Vision Quest premiere; hit shows Reacher and Crystal Lake keep drawing attention.
